description: The bar chart, labeled Figure 2, illustrates the average accuracy across 11 datasets for different training methods. The x-axis represents the training methods, listed in the order: Standard Self-RAG, FactTune, CINGS (w/ CONTEXT SUP.), and CINGS, while the y-axis represents the average accuracy, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, marked at intervals of 10. The chart features four bars, each corresponding to a training method, colored in green and blue, with the exact shades used for each method not specified in the chart. The bar for Standard Self-RAG has a value of approximately 46, FactTune is around 50, CINGS (w/ CONTEXT SUP.) is about 52, and CINGS is roughly 55. The bars are not sorted in any particular order other than the categorical order on the x-axis, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart effectively compares the average accuracy of the four training methods across the 11 datasets.
